fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A harrying weapon strike that deals 18 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Thrown for the Pack
fusions.desc: Throws a bone that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, and the pack piles in after it, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Groom and Lick
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Retriever's Share
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing them by 15% for 2 seconds. Each kill it brings back restores 3 health to you.
